name: 'In You We Trust, Not Algorithms': Newbie Matsumoto's Manual Elevator Operation with Sticky Notes
summary: A hyper-stressful, strictly manual elevator simulation! You're the corporation's new "control system" (a human). Drag and drop sticky notes to transport employees. Amidst massive clock-out rushes and blaring complaints, can you survive this extreme one-man shift?!
